A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TSD-SR. Their text, equations, seven tables, thirteen figures, and Appendices A–E are readable and can be matched despite page reflow.

before.justification: v3 reports original super-resolution benchmark results, ablations, computational measurements, and user studies in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original benchmark results, ablations, computational measurements, and user studies, including the additional preference results in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The student/teacher/LoRA architecture, TSD and TSM losses, DASM procedure, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Corrections to Figure 2's caption and the pixel-space LPIPS explanation clarify the procedure already specified by the equations and algorithm.

E1.justification: Both use DIV2K, Flickr2K, LSDIR, and the first 10,000 FFHQ faces for training, with DIV2K-Val, RealSR, and DRealSR evaluation. User-study categories and appendix comparison scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1–7 and the qualitative comparisons. This includes the single-step and multi-step diffusion baselines, the AddSR/SD2-base and OSEDiff/SD2.1-base controls, and the BSRGAN, Real-ESRGAN, LDL, and FeMaSR appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: Both retain the 3,000 synthetic evaluation pairs, image resolutions, degradation pipeline, metrics, backbone controls, training settings, and A100 timing protocol. The main user study still uses 50 participants with the same selection criteria.

E4.justification: The TSM/DASM ablations, same-backbone comparisons, and DASM hyperparameter analyses in Tables 4–6 are retained. Gradient analyses in Figures 3–5 and the perception-versus-fidelity comparisons in Appendix C and Figure 13 also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Figure 5 retains the same mean and standard-deviation display, while benchmark tables retain point estimates. Neither version reports seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–7 and the figure images match. The main and appendix user-study percentages remain 69.2% and 90.28%, respectively. Changes such as 57.60% to 57.6% are equivalent formatting.

T1.justification: Equations 1–12 and Appendix D's MSE, diffusion-Jacobian, and KL-divergence reasoning are retained. Mathematical edits concern spacing or notation; the revised intuitive explanations do not introduce new formal definitions, assumptions, or proofs.

C1.justification: Both claim one-step Real-ISR distillation, improved realism through TSD, improved detail recovery through DASM, and superior restoration and inference efficiency, including approximately 40-fold speed relative to SeeSR. Rewording does not materially change these contributions or their scope.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 corrects the misleading description of VSD's teacher prediction as operating on HQ latents, instead explaining student alignment with teacher priors consistently with Equation 3. Section 3.4 refines the explanation of missing high-frequency information by referring to the unnoised output latent. The parameter-count limitation remains unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the code statement from 'will be released' to 'is released' at the same repository. This changes reported availability, although actual access cannot be verified from the PDFs. Implementation settings, hardware, and training-time disclosures are retained.

R1.justification: Both retain the same 68 cited works and research positioning relative to VSD, OSEDiff, other diffusion methods, and GAN approaches. Bibliography differences are page back-references rather than added or removed research.

P1.justification: Extensive sentence and paragraph rewriting affects the introduction, methodology, experimental discussion, conclusion, and Appendices A–C. Grammar, terminology, and explanatory prose are substantially edited, although the section sequence and scientific scope remain stable.

P2.justification: Figures and table structures are retained, but several captions are rewritten, including the corrected Figure 2 caption. Text and equations reflow, and the existing acknowledgments move from page 9 to a separate page 10, shifting the appendices without adding scientific displays.

improvement.justification: v4 improves readability and corrects misleading VSD/TSM descriptions in Section 3.3 and Figure 2, bringing the prose into agreement with the retained equations and algorithm. It also updates reported code availability. These are limited gains because the experimental and theoretical evidence is unchanged; the mostly empty acknowledgment page is a small layout drawback.
